counting_policy: reference_value_count counts output scalar targets, excluding input coordinates, metadata and additional source-table anchors. Published tabulation conversions are not additional independent measurements.

packs.title: Reviewed plasma reference equations and published tables
packs.scope: Public plasma equations, selected published table anchors and physical constants.
packs.limitations: Reference derivation only; no production solver is executed. Bosch-Hale 1993 erratum remains unreviewed; regression tolerances are separate from physical uncertainty.

packs.title: Published fusion data: SI conversion and event-rate normalisation
packs.scope: Thirty NRL Maxwellian reactivities for DT, DD-total and D-He3, with thirty SI conversions and thirty event-rate targets.
packs.limitations: The producer reads the published table and checks conversion and pair counting. It does not independently predict reactivity; DD branches are not resolved and chosen densities are not measurements.

packs.title: Classical deuterium plasma characteristic scales
packs.scope: Ten characteristic plasma quantities at three chosen homogeneous deuterium states.
packs.limitations: Ideal classical equations and explicit species/temperature/frequency conventions. No experimental device data, kinetic corrections or confinement validation.

packs.title: Classical analytical benchmarks: oscillator, heat diffusion and circular orbit
packs.scope: Harmonic oscillator, one-dimensional heat diffusion and circular Kepler orbits.
packs.limitations: Ideal analytical verification at chosen sample points; no measured data, production solver, convergence study or long-time stability qualification.
